ch4_s1_evidence: Ada: In the deposition, Ivo says he did not call directly when the harbor repeated the east route. He knew at 21:09 that there was no repeat-back, but kept trying to restore the routing instead.

Ada: Ivo explicitly says there was no vessel hold at 21:04; that line was a water-level report. The crew were doing their required work. His account contradicts the summary’s claim that they disobeyed a hold.

Ada: Ivo says he knew at 21:09 that nobody had repeated the west correction. He still had time to call directly, but spent it repairing the apparatus. That specific admission belongs beside the coordinator’s obsolete route and the later concealment.
ch4_s2_evidence: Ada: Two off-island archives acknowledged complete copies with hashes and page counts, and Sera checked them against the local checksums. Both packets include the signed source register. The pressure machine is no longer the only place the evidence survives.

Ada: Sera verified source copies at two off-island archives, rather than relying on the pressure machine to retain them. Those copies include provenance and checksums. Nothing in that verification says the machine will remember everything forever.

Ada: The copies let us stop depending on the tower, not discard the originals. Sera included the signed source register in both packets and named a storage copy to go with the original reel to the hall. Preservation still matters.
ch4_s2a_evidence: Ada: Tomas can speak about his work and his father, but our list does not make him every family’s representative. Not all contacts were immediately reachable, and he explicitly separated publishing the operational finding from claiming their endorsement.

Ada: The statement includes people’s work and experience, not only the instrument. Our list gives Tomas his own archival work and relationship to Ewan to describe. That is a supported role; it still does not authorize speaking for every family.

Ada: Our four-column list gives Tomas his own archival work and relationship to Ewan to describe. It does not let him represent every family. The contacts we reached could choose copies or later contact; receiving a call is not endorsing our wording.
ch4_s4_evidence: Ada: Sera said the receiver has no trace on that part of the strip. We cannot infer a death, catastrophe or instruction from absent writing. Blank paper does not tell me I must die before writing again.

Ada: There is no recorded signal on that part of the receiving strip. Sera and Tomas kept the claim at that observation. It does not establish an outcome or add an instruction to the release checklist.

Ada: An unmarked strip records no signal; it does not forecast harmless weather. Nessa still reads the checklist: the catch-basin is empty and isolated, the shaft gate is locked, and the remaining crew have checked in. Those checks come from current conditions, not blank paper.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s1_evidence.text: You carry the sealed reel to the archive because the correct machine is there and because the keeper's kitchen has held enough for one day. Nessa assigns a deputy to the harbor desk before coming. Sera leaves her live pressure monitor with the maintenance crew. Nobody abandons the present to listen to the past.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s1_evidence.text: We make a preservation copy first. Then we listen together. I know waiting is unpleasant.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s1_evidence.text: Waiting isn't the same as hiding it.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s1_evidence.text: The reel begins with an identification spoken by an inquiry clerk. It is a deposition made three months after the flood. Ivo's voice sounds thinner than it does on the house recordings. A chair creaks before almost every answer. You hear him arranging his body around the act of speaking.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: clerk
ch4_s1_evidence.text: At what point did you understand that the west crew had not received a valid evacuation instruction?

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: ivo
ch4_s1_evidence.text: At twenty-one oh-nine, when the harbor repeated the east route and nobody repeated the west correction.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: clerk
ch4_s1_evidence.text: Did you call the harbor on the dedicated instruction channel?

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: ivo
ch4_s1_evidence.text: Not then.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: clerk
ch4_s1_evidence.text: Why not?

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: ivo
ch4_s1_evidence.text: I had sent the correction on the measurement channel. During the trial, the routing was meant to pass an urgent flag across. I thought it had crossed. Then I knew it had not. I kept trying to restore that route instead of using the direct line.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s1_evidence.text: Tomas stops the tape only long enough to mark a damaged section. Nobody speaks while he adjusts the head alignment. The pause feels like a door held open in a room you do not want to enter.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: clerk
ch4_s1_evidence.text: Was the routing issue known before the trial acceptance?

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: ivo
ch4_s1_evidence.text: Yes.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: clerk
ch4_s1_evidence.text: Why did you sign the system ready for supervised use?

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: ivo
ch4_s1_evidence.text: Because I believed I could supervise the weakness. Because the forecast marks had been right. Because I wanted the instrument to be useful before somebody took it away. Those are reasons. They are not a defense.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s1_evidence.text: He knew the difference.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: sera
ch4_s1_evidence.text: Yes.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s1_evidence.text: You have heard the sentence before, about channels. This time it means something larger and worse. A person can understand a safeguard and still make himself the exception he expects it to tolerate.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: ivo
ch4_s1_evidence.text: At twenty-one oh-six, the coordinator ordered rescue boats east, using the issued plan. I had the corrected chart. At twenty-one oh-eight, the west station asked for the sheltered approach. I sent the correction on A. At twenty-one oh-nine, I knew I had no repeat-back. I still had time to call directly. I spent it trying to make the apparatus work the way I had said it would.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: clerk
ch4_s1_evidence.text: Did Councillor Pell have access to the corrected chart?

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: ivo
ch4_s1_evidence.text: The office received it. I cannot say whether he read it. His instruction used the superseded route. My response failed to correct it. Both belong in the record.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: clerk
ch4_s1_evidence.text: And the later account of an unauthorized departure?

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: ivo
ch4_s1_evidence.text: The crew did not disobey a vessel hold at twenty-one oh-four. There was no such hold. That was a water-level report. They were where their work required them to be. The sentence in the summary is false.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s1_evidence.text: Tomas puts his hand flat on the table. It is the first time his composure has looked like effort rather than habit. Nessa moves the box of unused sleeves away from his elbow, giving him a little more space without touching him.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: clerk
ch4_s1_evidence.text: Why did you request removal of the corrected map from the published exhibit?

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: ivo
ch4_s1_evidence.text: Because it made the other omissions visible. Because I thought admitting one part would cost me the only work I still knew how to do. Because people who had already lost everything would have to wait, and I was willing to let them wait so I could keep my place.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s1_evidence.text: The voice is not asking you to admire its honesty. It is merely too late for the honesty to be the act it should have been.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: ivo
ch4_s1_evidence.text: Do not write that I was protecting the town. I was protecting myself inside the idea of the town. It is a comfortable place to hide if people have given you a key.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s1_evidence.text: Make space for Tomas after the unedited testimony.

conversation.prompt: Make space for Tomas after the unedited testimony.
suggestions: The record names what happened to your father's crew.
We can stop for a moment without stopping the work.
What do you need from us before the next section?
conversation.fallback: A moment, then the whole record. I don't want a triumphant clip. I want the instruction, the missing correction, and the names kept together.

ch4_s1_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s1_evidence.text: You take the moment. Tomas walks to the small window above the sink. He does not cry where you can see, which tells you nothing about whether he cries. Nessa checks her radio with its volume low. Sera writes the exact source reference on the transcript. You sit with your uncle's voice and decline, for once, to finish a sentence for him.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2_evidence.text: The second half of the reel is less dramatic and more important to anyone who will have to verify the first. The clerk asks about dates, office copies, who initialed the routing change, and which pages Ivo supplied to the summary editor. Tomas plays every answer. None of you has earned the right to call the boring part unnecessary.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: sera
ch4_s2_evidence.text: There are three distinct failures here. A known channel-routing problem accepted under supervision that wasn't adequate. An obsolete rescue route issued by the coordinator. A failure to make and verify a direct correction when the mismatch became clear. Then there is a fourth, separate wrong: the later public account concealed those facts.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Don't let the list make them sound independent. One put pressure on the next.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: sera
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Agreed. Separate for attribution, connected in cause.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2_evidence.text: And the machine predicting a surge doesn't make any of those instructions inevitable.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: sera
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Exactly. The measurement could be accurate while the response was wrong. A forecast of water is not a command to send a boat east.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2_evidence.text: You bring the public summary back to the table. Beside it you put the Channel A log, the corrected chart, and the photograph of Ivo's instruction to use the issued version. Four sources, each with its own reference. You have been looking at them for hours. Now you need to see whether you can explain their relation without borrowing certainty from his voice.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2_evidence.text: The summary says the west vessel was told to hold at 21:04. The log says WEST LEVEL HOLDING. We've established that those are different statements.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Keep the channel letter with the words. Someone reading the summary alone doesn't get that distinction.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2_evidence.text: You copy A beside the measurement. Then you read the next entry, B: AWAIT HARBOR. You leave that line intact too. It records what was awaited; it does not supply a vessel order hidden between the words.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Could the wrong instruction have come from a chart error? If they thought the west approach wasn't there—

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s2_evidence.text: That's the issued route problem. The corrected chart gives them a sheltered approach to consider. It doesn't turn a water reading into an instruction. We need to show both failures.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2_evidence.text: You have drawn one arrow between the summary and the missing chart. You rub it out. In its place you write two headings: what the crew were told, and what the public were later told about the crew. The page looks messier. Nessa rotates it so she can read the small lettering.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Ivo suppressed the corrected chart. He allowed the false hold claim to stand. Saying he suppressed both would get the direction of the second act wrong.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s2_evidence.text: And make it sound as though the falsehood was something he kept out of print. It was what people were left to read.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2_evidence.text: You check the omission note against the chart heading and retain its exact wording beneath the first claim. Under the second you cite the public summary, the channel log, and the point in the complete deposition where Ivo says there was no vessel hold. The same testimony can support a correction without becoming the only source for it.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: sera
ch4_s2_evidence.text: What can this page say about the editor?

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2_evidence.text: That the published exhibit used the issued version and the summary carried the false claim. Not that we've established what every person handling those pages knew.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Then leave that question open for review. We don't need to invent another confession to say the crew didn't disobey an order that wasn't there.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Tomas puts a blank correction card beside the four sources. Before this wording enters the deposit, he asks you to check it against both the chart instruction and the published summary. Which account preserves what Ivo kept out of the record and what he let remain in it?

activity.prompt: Which correction is supported by these sources?
options: Ivo withheld the corrected chart; the false vessel-hold claim remained in the public summary.
Ivo withheld both the corrected chart and the false vessel-hold claim.
The summary proves every editor knowingly concealed the correction.
activity.explanation: The omission note supports withholding the corrected chart. The published summary contains the false hold claim, contradicted by the Channel A measurement log and the deposition. What each editor knew remains a question for independent review.
optionFeedback: Tomas turns the summary toward you. 'The hold claim is printed here. Keeping it out would have left a different public record.' The omission note concerns the corrected chart. Compare what was withheld with what readers were left to believe.

Sera taps the source references. 'We can show what the exhibit used and what the summary said. That does not establish what every editor knew.' Preserve those questions for independent review; the crew's correction does not depend on inventing another person's confession.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Tomas catches your pencil before it rolls into the chart's curled edge. He sets it beside the source register, then asks you to read the two headings once more. This time he does not correct either. You keep the crossed-out arrow visible in the working notes. It records a mistake you made and checked, rather than one a later reader must unknowingly inherit.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Nessa lays the modern repeat-back protocol beside the old handover. On one page, named people acknowledge specific instructions. On the other, responsibility sits in the passive voice: the warning will be relayed, the channel will be monitored, the route will be confirmed. No sentence says by whom.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s2_evidence.text: This is why I am irritating about names on a list.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s2_evidence.text: You've earned a little more irritation.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s2_evidence.text: I'll try not to become extravagant.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Tomas writes the six crew members' names on a new source card: Ewan Rook, Leila Fen, Ruth Merrin, Oren Pike, Hester Cole, and Dev Malik. He has written them so often that the movement looks practiced. He adds their roles, then stops before adding anything sentimental.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s2_evidence.text: They were a crew. They were doing maintenance and recovery work. I don't want us to turn them into six symbols because that's easier than six people.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Can the public archive include their ordinary records too? Photographs, interviews, what they made, if the families want that.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s2_evidence.text: If the families want it. That part matters.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2_evidence.text: You draft a short catalogue note. You name the original sources, distinguish direct quotation from interpretation, and state the limits. The records establish that the public claim of a vessel hold is unsupported and contradicted by the original measurement log and testimony. They establish Ivo's knowledge and omission. They do not determine every individual legal liability, and tonight's team does not pretend to conduct a new tribunal around a tape deck.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2_evidence.text: 'These materials warrant independent review and correction of the public record.'

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Keep that. Remove 'finally.' It tells people how to feel about the timing instead of showing them the dates.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s2_evidence.text: The dates are worse.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2_evidence.text: You remove it. Precision has become a form of solidarity rather than restraint. It prevents the work from being dismissed as grief with a microphone.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Discuss how to communicate the findings.

conversation.prompt: Discuss how to communicate the findings.
suggestions: What is supported, and what still needs independent review?
Let's distinguish technical failure from the choice to conceal it.
How do we keep the evidence accessible after tonight?
conversation.fallback: Release the source copies with provenance, readable transcripts, and explicit limits. Preserve independent copies away from the tower. Let a qualified review determine conclusions these records alone cannot support.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Sera confirms that two off-island recipients have acknowledged complete copies: the municipal records service and the regional maritime archive. The acknowledgments include file hashes and page counts. Nessa has authority to lodge operational records; Ada authorizes deposit of the relevant estate papers she administers. Nothing leaves the island merely because somebody pressed send and hoped.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s2_evidence.text: The copies arrived?

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: sera
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Verified against the local checksums. The signed source register is in both packets. One storage drive also goes to the school hall with the original reel.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Then the tower is no longer the only place the truth lives.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s2_evidence.text: It should never have been.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2_evidence.text: That sentence changes the shape of the evening. You can lose a machine without losing the evidence. You can dismantle the instrument without making Ivo's last act a fresh monopoly on what everyone else is allowed to know.

ch4_s2_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2_evidence.text: Outside, the first heavy gust hits the archive door. Tomas steadies the lamp. It remains lit. The room has work left to do, but it is no longer the only room in the world capable of doing it.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Before the statement leaves the room, you ask who should read it. The question seems administrative until everybody answers at once. Nessa says the harbor. Tomas says the families should be informed first. Sera says the technical claims need review. You say the estate documents need clear attribution. Then all four of you stop, hearing how easily necessary concerns can become competing claims to a microphone.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Let's separate the jobs.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Public operational authority, family notification, technical accuracy, source ownership.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: And nobody can perform all four merely because their voice carries.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: You draw four columns. Nessa can speak for current harbor operations and lodge municipal records. Tomas can describe his own work and his relationship to Ewan, but cannot speak for every family. Sera can state what the physical evidence supports, not announce a complete scientific theory. You can authorize the relevant estate material and describe its provenance, not decide the community's response to it.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: sera
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: A good boundary is sometimes a list of things you don't represent.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: We should put that where the audience can see it.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Without making the statement so cautious it says nothing.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: It can say the concrete thing plainly. The public claim of a vessel hold is contradicted by original evidence. No throat-clearing needed before that.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: You read the draft aloud. Hearing it exposes a sentence that looked responsible on the page but sounds evasive: errors appear to have occurred. Tomas makes a face. You replace it with the supported sequence of actions and the names established by the records.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: 'The coordinator issued the obsolete east route. Ivo sent the west correction on the measurement channel, recognized there was no repeat-back, and did not use the direct line in the remaining interval.'

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: sera
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Better. It names actions without pretending this room has determined every legal conclusion.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: And the concealment?

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: 'The later summary substituted a water-level measurement for a vessel instruction, and the corrected chart was knowingly excluded from the published exhibit.'

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Attribute what we know about knowingly to Ivo's note and testimony. We can't attach his state of mind to every person involved in publication.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: You make the attribution explicit. The paragraph becomes longer and more honest. It still fits on a page. You are beginning to understand how much damage a very short summary can do when its economy is borrowed from somebody else's missing qualification.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Tomas calls the family contacts who agreed to receive archive updates. He does not perform these calls on speaker. You work quietly while he speaks at the far end of the room. After each call, he records whether the person received the information, wanted a copy now, or preferred contact after the storm. Declining an immediate conversation does not make anyone less entitled to the later record.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Are they all reachable?

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Not all immediately. I've left neutral callback requests where appropriate. We can publish the operational finding without claiming every family has endorsed our wording. Those are different permissions.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: We also won't postpone correcting a public falsehood indefinitely because a notification chain takes time. We document who was reached and keep trying responsibly.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: One relative sends a photograph of an old letter and asks Tomas to publish it alongside the statement. He reads enough to identify it, then replies that the document needs separate review and provenance before it becomes part of the collection. He looks unhappy at delaying something offered so urgently.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Grief can make speed feel like respect.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Sometimes respect is telling someone what you can actually verify today.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: sera
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: And preserving the offered original so tomorrow remains possible.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: A second complication arrives from the council office: a request to see the wording before public release. Nessa reads it twice. It contains no emergency order, no privacy issue, and no identification of a specific error. It asks for time to consider reputational implications.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: We'll send the source list and the draft as notice. The operational records are public. The estate has authorized the relevant documents. They can identify an error, and we will correct one. A general wish to consider how this looks is not grounds to conceal it tonight.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: We should include the response in the publication history.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Yes. Fairly. They are allowed to be surprised. They are not allowed to make surprise everybody else's waiting room.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: You make a versioned statement, record the time, and retain the previous draft. It feels excessive until you remember the selected inquiry summary. The difference between a correction and an invisible substitution begins with keeping a record of the change.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: sera
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Include a contact route for corrections, and distinguish it from the emergency phone. We don't want the safety line occupied by someone debating a transcript comma.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Although some of the commas are doing quite a lot.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: They can do it on the archive line.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: The room laughs, briefly. Then Tomas asks for one more change. The statement should not call the crew vindicated as if their lives had been a court case awaiting a satisfying final word. It should state the corrected facts. He wants people to know what was false, not only that someone has won an argument.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: What word would you use?

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Named. Heard. Accurately described. Any of those, in the right sentence.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: You remove vindicated from a proposed heading. The replacement reads ORIGINAL RECORDS OF WEST QUAY RESPONSE, 1998. Less dramatic. More durable. It will make sense after the emotional temperature of tonight has changed.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Sera checks the technical appendix. She strikes out one phrase describing the chronograph as a machine that predicts the future. The observed effect concerns a fixed backward trace. Prediction is one possible use of information received early, not a complete account of the mechanism. The distinction matters both scientifically and politically.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: sera
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: If we say it predicted the flood, readers may imagine it supplied a perfect safety plan. The record shows the opposite problem. Information arrived, and the human response mishandled it.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: The title should not recreate the mistake the evidence reveals.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: There is a whole career in that sentence.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: You keep the extraordinary instrument in a separate technical note rather than allowing it to swallow the operational finding. The crew did not need time travel to deserve a valid rescue instruction. Their families do not have to persuade the world that a strange machine worked before the corrected channel log can matter.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: That's important. People can question the physical explanation and still read the ordinary records correctly.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: sera
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: They should. Independent claims need independent support.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: By the time the final draft is ready, it has become less elegant and more useful. It names sources, actions, limits, permissions, and the route for future correction. It contains no demand that anyone feel closure. It fits within the existing emergency communication plan and leaves the safety channel clear.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: I used to think a good public statement was one nobody could misunderstand.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: An ambitious genre.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Now I'd settle for one that gives a reasonable reader enough to check us.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: That is a much better job description.

ch4_s2a_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s2a_evidence.text: Tomas takes the printed page. Nessa takes the radio. Sera takes the measured conditions. You take the source register. No one carries the whole account alone when you leave the archive.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s4_evidence.text: The tower service clock reads 18:58. Sera has arranged yesterday's photographs in order along a clean bench. The first mysterious sentence was already present in the photograph taken at 19:58 yesterday. The second was recorded as it formed at 20:03. Add twenty-three hours and seventeen minutes, and the corresponding input times are this evening at 19:15 and 19:20.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s4_evidence.text: Seventeen minutes until the first.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: sera
ch4_s4_evidence.text: Until the input time consistent with the recorded output. We should be careful with the word until. It can make an appointment sound like an order.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s4_evidence.text: You're being very precise about a thing that is making my stomach hurt.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: sera
ch4_s4_evidence.text: Precision is what I have available.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s4_evidence.text: On the input platen, your practice sentence waits in a detachable test frame. The tiny terminal hooks match the mysterious text. You recognize another feature now: the lower-case f in falls leans left when you write quickly, because you learned to avoid the ink your hand would smear.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s4_evidence.text: It isn't Ivo imitating me.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s4_evidence.text: Nobody tells you it never could have been. You have all spent the day earning the right to become more certain.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s4_evidence.text: I write the cup note. I already know what happened to it, and I know the handle led us to the plate. I write the bell line because we're about to make the release safe. The machine carries my hand back to yesterday. There isn't a hidden person on the other side.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s4_evidence.text: There's you, at the other end of the day.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s4_evidence.text: He didn't predict my arrival in a letter. He left equipment and evidence. I made the message that brought me to them.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: sera
ch4_s4_evidence.text: That is the account supported by the traces and their timing. One self-consistent history. No changed record, no erased version of you, no evidence of another branch.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s4_evidence.text: And no reason to skip the last safety check.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s4_evidence.text: You laugh once, without much amusement, then feel grateful for the sentence. It returns the room to a size in which your hands can do something useful.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s4_evidence.text: Does the blank part mean anything?

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: sera
ch4_s4_evidence.text: It means the receiver has no trace there. We cannot infer a death, a catastrophe, or an instruction from the absence of writing.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s4_evidence.text: Blank paper is allowed to be blank paper.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s4_evidence.text: You think of last night at the glass pane, giving every empty centimeter a possible ending. You had treated absence as if it were a message too, and then blamed the paper for frightening you.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s4_evidence.text: Ask about authorship, the blank strip, and the fixed loop.

conversation.prompt: Ask about authorship, the blank strip, and the fixed loop.
suggestions: Why doesn't the blank strip mean something terrible happens?
Have we seen any evidence of a changed timeline?
Can I write for a reason instead of writing because I'm afraid?
conversation.fallback: The blank strip contains no recorded signal. The observed record remains one consistent history. Your reasons can be the evidence and the safe plan; the machine supplies no additional moral authority.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s4_evidence.text: Nessa reads the release checklist aloud. The downstream catch-basin is empty and isolated. The tower shaft gate is locked. The inland path is clear. The remaining maintenance crew have checked in at the hall. The four of you are the only people outside that shelter, all on the high tower landing, all accounted for.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s4_evidence.text: If anyone chooses to leave now, we can operate with three. If two choose to leave, we call the crew chief back over the radio and follow the alternative. Nobody's consent is a structural component.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: ada
ch4_s4_evidence.text: I'm staying.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: tomas
ch4_s4_evidence.text: Me too.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: sera
ch4_s4_evidence.text: I need to read the pressure gauges. I'm staying for that reason.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: nessa
ch4_s4_evidence.text: Good. Write the reason down if it helps. Then we do the next check.

ch4_s4_evidence.speaker: narrator
ch4_s4_evidence.text: Ada Vale, catalogue consultant, remains voluntarily at the tower release station. You write your name on the operations sheet in your ordinary hand. It looks like a small act of authorship. For once, you do not need it to be more.
